target_name: Balance Sheet Accrual Credibility Capital Return
rationale: The balance-sheet accrual construction is a legitimate, coverage-restoring alternative measurement of the archive's best-performing credibility channel (0.078 → ~0.11) rather than a pure operator tweak, though it remains an incremental re-measurement of an already-tested mechanism and imports a well-known standalone anomaly (Sloan accruals) as the weight.

Swapping MUL for MIN on two [0,1] ranks is close to cosmetic — the two combinations are highly rank-correlated — and the MIN-of-two-ranks structure has already been used twice in the archive (Double Confirmation Value Payout, Unlevered Cheap Repurchaser) with weak portfolio evidence, so this is unlikely to diagnose why the three-way product diluted the slope.

Dropping the net-debt-issuance term is a directed, economically motivated ablation that cleanly separates "certified equity payout" from "certified total claim contraction," but it is a single-term deletion from an existing signal and the resulting payout leg is close to the published net-payout-yield anomaly, so the incremental information is modest.

target_name: Revenue Multiple Cheapness With Credible Earnings
rationale: Substituting sales-to-EV for EBITDA-to-EV is a genuinely different valuation leg with a coherent rationale (deliberately decorrelating from RMW/HML, which have plausibly absorbed prior spreads) and industry ranking is correctly justified, though coverage will remain pinned near 0.078 by the retained oancf term — the very limitation Signal 1 sets out to fix.

target_name: Payout At Own History High When Cheap
rationale: The five-year within-firm rank is a sensible fix for the noisy one-year payout difference, but the expression is internally inconsistent on the short side: because TS_RANK is strictly non-negative and multiplies a signed payout, a net issuer that is issuing *less* than its own history receives a *more* negative score than one issuing at its five-year extreme, inverting the intended ordering for exactly the firms the hypothesis claims to identify.

target_name: Accrual Inflated Issuance At Rich Enterprise Value
rationale: The three-way rich × accrual-inflated × issuing construction is a distinct combination rather than a rediscovery of the archive's two prior short-side attempts, and the sign convention is internally consistent, but the same non-negative-weight asymmetry places rich, accrual-heavy *repurchasers* in the long leg, and every previous rich-issuance variant produced FF5 alpha of the wrong sign, so the prior is unfavorable.
